landing.tagline: Emerging-Tech Skills, Built for Every Community
landing.heroSubtitle: Master in-demand digital skills — AI, cybersecurity, data science, and more — and get rewarded with W3TR as you learn, teach, and contribute.
landing.step1Body: Take mobile-first courses from instructors teaching real, in-demand digital skills.
landing.step2Body: Apply what you learn to build real projects and solutions — not just theory — tackling problems that matter in your community and career.
landing.step3Body: Earn W3TR rewards and verifiable certificates as you progress — proof employers can trust.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join thousands of Nigerians learning emerging technology skills — free to start.
landing.countryReadyHeading: Built for Nigeria. Ready for the World.
landing.countryReadyBody: Every country's learners, languages, and regulations are different — so the platform itself is built to be configured for any country on demand: languages, states and regions, and compliance settings can all be adapted. We're solving Nigeria's digital skills gap first, because Nigeria is where we are — the architecture was never built to stop there.

auth.loginSubtitle: Log in to continue learning, teaching, and earning W3TR.
auth.registerSubtitle: Join a national community of learners, instructors, and builders.
